name: chromodomain helicase DNA binding protein 3

function.text: CHD3 is the approved symbol for chromodomain helicase DNA binding protein 3. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in ATP hydrolysis activity; ATP-dependent chromatin remodeler activity; centrosome cycle.

germline.text: Retained strong or definitive GenCC associations include Snijders Blok-Campeau syndrome (autosomal dominant). Allele and inheritance require review.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Head and neck squamous cell carcinoma; Low-grade glioma; Lung adenocarcinoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; Definitive GenCC assertion, ClinGen. Allele-specific review required.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Historical hotspot cohort observation; individual-allele significance and tumor-specific oncogenicity require review.

function.text: CHD3 encodes chromodomain helicase DNA binding protein 3. Its functions include ATP hydrolysis activity and ATP-dependent chromatin remodeler activity.

germline.text: Germline disease associations include Snijders Blok-Campeau syndrome (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CHD3 have been reported in low-grade glioma, lung adenocarcinoma, and pancreatic adenocarcinoma. Recurrence alone does not establish the oncogenicity of an individual variant.
